import sys,json,pathlib,os,datetime,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path(".").resolve()/"current_preparation_family"; files=json.loads(sys.argv[1])
print(json.dumps({"actual_writer_pid":os.getpid(),"utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"root":str(root),"prewrite_existing":root.exists(),"existing":([{"path":str(p.relative_to(root)),"bytes":p.stat().st_size if p.is_file() else None} for p in root.rglob("*")] if root.exists() else [])}),flush=True)
assert not (root/"SOURCE.json").exists(),"do not rewrite a historical seal"
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for n,s in files.items():
 p=root/n; raw=s.encode()
 if p.exists(): assert p.read_bytes()==raw,"unexpected partial:"+n
 else:
  with p.open("xb") as f: f.write(raw); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
 print(json.dumps({"saved":n,"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}),flush=True)
